lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a patterned distribution across the visible mid-lateral flank, appearing in staggered horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern on the shark's flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge feature extending horizontally across the upper visible flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and lower intensity in the shadow-facing ventral edge.
